summary: The heart of the library. Test extends superagent's Request, deferring dispatch until an implicit server is actually listening, then running a chain of status/header/body assertions and handing (err, res) to a callback. 86 real commits, the most actively maintained file in the repo; several of its functions have their own multi-year fix history below.
